refuse.same-pin: Pick a different pin. A wire needs two ends.
refuse.no-such-pin: {end} is not a pin on this part. The wire was not made.
refuse.mechanical-pin: {end} is a mounting point, not an electrical pin. The wire was not made.
refuse.not-on-view: {part} is not on the board yet. Place it first, then wire it.
refuse.hole-not-on-surface: {hole} is not a hole on this breadboard.
refuse.same-strip: {a} and {b} are already connected inside the breadboard.
refuse.duplicate-wire: {a} and {b} already have a wire between them.
refuse.empty-target: No pin there. The wire was not made.
refuse.quota: This project has reached a size limit ({limit}). Remove something before adding more.
refuse.permission: You are viewing this project. Ask the owner for edit access.
refuse.read-only: This project is open read only, so it cannot be changed here.

announce.removedWireNet: Wire removed. Net {net} still connects {a} and {b}.
announce.rotateBlocked: Parts seated in the breadboard stay on the grid and cannot be rotated.
announce.nothingToWire: Select a part first, then press W to wire it.
announce.noFreePin: {part} has no free pin to start a wire from.
announce.noNet: The selection is not on a net.

pinPicker.searchHint: Type a part and a pin, like led1 anode or d13. Enter picks the highlighted pin.

outline.title: Outline
outline.emptyHint: Add a part from the palette and it shows up here.

edit.deleteDrawing: Delete the drawing only and keep the connection
edit.enter: Drop a part, or open the inspector

move.left: Move left, or focus the previous part (Shift ten steps, Alt fine)
move.right: Move right, or focus the next part (Shift ten steps, Alt fine)
move.up: Move up, or focus the previous part (Shift ten steps, Alt fine)
move.down: Move down, or focus the next part (Shift ten steps, Alt fine)

view.pan: Pan with the mouse while held
